answers.workaround:
Well I tried it and I'd gotten up to 18 lines before realising that the wildcard problem did not have a trivial solution.

Furthermore having it implemented in engine would give godot more safeguards over preventing a recursive directory search from getting stuck in an infinite loop if implemented by a less experienced developer.
